capabilities: Track physical items, recurring subscriptions, and one-time experiences as Markdown records
Log usage, maintenance, regret, and review notes for owned objects
Record snapshots of net worth and account balances
Plan trips with day-by-day schedules, maps, budgets, and expense splitting
Show insights such as annualized subscription costs and net-worth trends
extras: Freemium: 'Insights (Pro)' features (travel insights, object insights, calendar feed) are paid. Also ships a companion Web/PWA app, Agent CLI, and local MCP server sharing the same data model; data folder can live inside a Dropbox/Google Drive/OneDrive/iCloud-synced folder without provider APIs. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later.
motivation: The README's 'Why Ownly' section says the goal is 'Own less, Live more, Decide better' by keeping a decision-led record from acquire to exit.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a structured record of possessions, recurring costs, and purchase decisions with usage and review history.

relations.evidence: Capture places from Google Maps with the companion Ownly Capture browser extension

requires.name: Ownly Capture browser extension (for Google Maps capture)

summary: Local-first ownership ledger that tracks physical items, subscriptions, experiences, and costs as Markdown records in a chosen vault folder.
